_readme: Description of Outerplane: its raw characters (heads converted into a donor PMX by tools/head/outerplane.py, library.py extract --outerplane).

_fr_ok.controle.glb: file name set by the third-party extraction tool that lays out the character folders
_fr_ok.rendu.json: same: file name set by the third-party extraction tool

title: Outerplane

compatibility._readme: What the tool does with this game's models, according to the code and the data of 15/11/2026. Read by python3 -I tools/games; COMPATIBILITY.md is drawn from it. No other tool reads it.
compatibility.summary: The heads are converted and stored in the face library, but Chimera offers none of them today.
compatibility.origin: An extraction of the game files by a third-party tool, laid out in the format of our extraction tool: one folder per character with `controle.glb` (mesh, bones, morphs), `rendu.json` (materials and textures) and the textures. No tool in this repository produces this format.

people.content: one folder per character (`<id>` or `<id>_<Name>`) with `controle.glb`, `rendu.json` and the textures named by `rendu.json`

heads.detail: Converted into a donor PMX (tools/head/outerplane.py), then measured like a ZZZ head: 60 heads stored out of 78 on 15/11/2026, 14 rejected (eyeball welded to the skin, eyebrows without geometry), 4 left out. Not in Chimera's catalogue: running them through Chimera has never been tried. 16 heads do not close their eyes (blink at 30-93 %).

hairstyles.detail: 44 hairstyles measured in the face library, but not offered: Chimera only takes the hairstyles of a character whose outfit is cut.

clothes.detail: The donor PMX contains only the head: cutting the outfits has never been done on these models.

expressions.detail: The EYE_* and MOUTH_* morphs are renamed to MMD names ("morphs_mmd") during the conversion; the others keep their names. In the donor PMX only.

steps: Put the character folders in `{data}/sources/outerplane/people` (or write its path under `games.outerplane.people` in the settings). Check: `python3 -I tools/games` counts the folders that have `controle.glb` and `rendu.json`.

Heads: the ZZZ pipeline must have produced the pivot head (`<data>/pivot-head`), then `<python> -I tools/head/library.py extract --outerplane --output <data>/face-library`; a single head as a trial: `<python> -I tools/head/outerplane.py convert <character folder> <output.pmx>`.
limits: Cannot be the active game (`games.active`): its description has neither a base head nor a list of models. Its heads go through the pivot head of the active game (ZZZ).
The "materials" table (FACE, FACE_EYE, HAIR, BODY) assumes this game's M_<id>_… material names; cutting the face into eyes, mouth and eyebrows is done by geometry and failed on 14 heads.

_excluded: heads left out of the spectrum (the research notes, "Outerplane (06/11)"): not playable characters with a human face, or duplicates

excluded.2000034: covered face (left out of the spectrum)

_materials: Outerplane material names in the common language (tools/games/README.md), first matching pattern wins. A game GLB has four useful materials, M_<id>_FACE, _FACE_EYE, _HAIR…, _BODY… (M_<id>_ prefix optional, case-insensitive). FACE is not only the skin: tools/head/outerplane.py then cuts it by geometry into 颜, 目, 目光, 二重, 齿, 口舌, 颜2, 飾り; FACE_EYE (eyelashes and eyebrows mixed) into 眉 and 睫. BODY: clothed one-piece body, like 体 in ZZZ. Read by outerplane.py (role of each primitive) and by atlas/pmx.lire for a PMX stored in its source folders (there are none today).
_morphs_mmd: MMD names of the Outerplane morphs (after the typos are normalized); the others keep their names (EYE_SHY, MOUTH_PAIN...), in the eye or mouth panel
